business_summary: Shanxi Guoxin Energy Corporation Limited engages natural gas development and utilization, and consulting services. It is also involved in the provision of gas storage facilities leasing services; development, construction, operation, management, and heating of central heating projects; production, processing, and sales of natural gas stoves and instrumentation equipment; information technology development and consulting services; and import and export business, as well as hydrogen energy technology research and development, geothermal energy, wind energy, solar energy, energy-saving technology consulting, biomass energy technical services, technology development, technology exchange, technology transfer, and technology promotion. It also offers urban domestic waste resource treatment and utilization; straw technology consulting and technology promotion; biomass biogas technology consulting; wind power generation technology services, sales of new energy prime movers, solar power generation technology services; oil and gas technology services; and new material technology promotion services, as well as power supply, power generation business, and construction and management of new energy charging piles. The company was formerly known as Shanghai Lianhua Synthetic Fiber Co., Ltd. and changed its name to Shanxi Guoxin Energy Corporation Limited in July 2014. The company was founded in 1992 and is based in Taiyuan, China.
business_summary_ko: Shanxi Guoxin Energy Corporation Limited는 천연가스 개발 및 활용, 컨설팅 서비스를 제공합니다. 또한 가스 저장 시설 임대 서비스 제공에도 참여합니다. 중앙 난방 프로젝트의 개발, 건설, 운영, 관리 및 난방; 천연가스 스토브 및 계측 장비의 생산, 가공, 판매; 정보 기술 개발 및 컨설팅 서비스; 수출입사업, 수소에너지 기술 연구개발, 지열에너지, 풍력에너지, 태양에너지, 에너지절약 기술컨설팅, 바이오매스에너지 기술서비스, 기술개발, 기술교류, 기술이전, 기술진흥 등을 담당하고 있습니다. 또한 도시 생활 폐기물 자원 처리 및 활용도 제공합니다. 밀짚 기술 컨설팅 및 기술 홍보; 바이오매스 바이오가스 기술 컨설팅; 풍력 발전 기술 서비스, 신에너지 원동력 판매, 태양광 발전 기술 서비스; 석유 및 가스 기술 서비스; 신소재 기술 진흥 서비스, 전력공급, 발전사업, 신에너지 건설 및 관리 등의 사업을 영위하고 있습니다.
